info.name: Minis n More API — Module wise (2xx tests)
info.description:
Generated from OpenAPI. Each request asserts HTTP 2xx.

1. Set environment: email, password, baseUrl.
2. Run folder **00 Setup** or POST /api/authenticate.
3. Run other modules (Collection Runner).

Note: POST/PUT/DELETE may need valid ids/data; public GET storefront endpoints work without auth.

exec: // Use collection authToken if environment authToken is empty

item.name: 00 Setup (run first)
item.description: Authenticate to set authToken for protected modules.
